name: AIZO Group Berhad
overview: 今年公司的主要业务动态集中在 Bituminous Products 板块：与 K2 Bitumen 就 Sarawak 的 Green Bitumen Facility 签署的谅解备忘录持续更新，但公告显示自上次公告以来没有进一步重大进展。集团层面推进了私下配售、股本削减和供股等企业活动，其中股本削减已于 2026 年 10 月 13 日生效，私下配售第一批和第二批分别于 9 月 4 日和 9 月 30 日完成。此外，与 NetRunner 就 Sarawak Tier 4 Data Center Hub 的谅解备忘录也持续更新，同样没有进一步重大进展。
overview_en: The main business developments this year centred on the Bituminous Products segment: the MOU with K2 Bitumen for a Green Bitumen Facility in Sarawak continued to be updated, but announcements stated there was no further material development since the previous announcement.

segments.name: 沥青产品
segments.note: 与 K2 Bitumen 探讨在 Sarawak 设立并运营 Green Bitumen Facility 的谅解备忘录今年多次更新，但均无进一步重大进展。
segments.note_en: The MOU with K2 Bitumen to explore the establishment and operation of a Green Bitumen Facility in Sarawak was updated several times this year, but no further material development was reported.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面推进私下配售、股本削减和供股等企业活动，并与 NetRunner 就 Sarawak Tier 4 Data Center Hub 的谅解备忘录持续更新。
segments.note_en: At the group level, corporate exercises including a private placement, share capital reduction and rights issue progressed, and the MOU with NetRunner for a Tier 4 Data Center Hub in Sarawak continued…

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 批准将私下配售和供股的完成期限延长至 2027 年 4 月 15 日；股本削减已于 2026 年 10 月 13 日完成。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities granted an extension of time up to 15 April 2027 for the completion of the private placement and rights issue; the share capital reduction was completed on 13 October 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text_en: The share capital reduction became effective on 13 October 2026, with the issued share capital at RM50,112,342.94 comprising 2,143,233,547 shares.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 私下配售第二批完成，122,500,000 股配售股份于 2026 年 9 月 30 日在 Bursa Securities 主板上市。
actions.text_en: The second tranche of the private placement was completed with 122,500,000 placement shares listed on the Main Market of Bursa Securities on 30 September 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 私下配售第一批完成，7,500,000 股配售股份于 2026 年 9 月 4 日在 Bursa Securities 主板上市。
actions.text_en: The first tranche of the private placement was completed with 7,500,000 placement shares listed on the Main Market of Bursa Securities on 4 September 2026.
